title: ‘Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’ Is Figuring Out How Show Moves Forward, Says Disney Unscripted Chief
summary: "We wanted to make sure [the cast feels] good about returning. We never would have gone back if it was anything other than that," Rob Mills tells The Hollywood Reporter, while revealing more details about the hit Hulu reality series, how they courted 'Summer House' star Ciara Miller for 'DWTS' and the state of 'The Bachelor' franchise.
